scenario: Date comparison is lexicographic per LTIM.5.3. `s.due < t.due` (Date < Date) compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Task scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    due: Date mutable

rule r:
    Task s where s.entity_id == "a"
    Task t where t.entity_id == "b" and s.due < t.due
->
    log info "ordered"
